data.name: Chair-Riot
data.detailed_description:
Race through ChairCo’s underground test facility as a freshly recruited chairtronaut in a high-speed, precision-piloting challenge that turns the humble office chair into a weapon of corporate glory. Chair-Riot blends snappy arcade controls with leaderboard-driven competition, letting you drift, dodge, and speed through passive-aggressive obstacle courses. Unlock deeper floors, master the Mark I, and claim your name in glorious red LED lights—one perfectly executed run at a time.

Features

  • Precision-focused arcade-style chair-piloting gameplay

  • Global leaderboards for every underground testing floor

  • Progressive level unlocking through ChairCo’s Secure Testing Facility

  • Passive-aggressive obstacles (because HR said “no more live tigers”)

Put your quick-twitch mouse skills to the ultimate test in Chair-Riot, where office chairs aren’t just for sitting—they’re for blazing through absurd corporate obstacle courses.

As ChairCo’s newest Top Gun chairtronaut, you’ve been hand-picked to pilot the legendary ChairCo Mark I (“ol’ Woody”) through the company’s underground testing facility. Your mission? Guide the Chair Track Indicator (the puck) through a maze of questionably designed test tracks and reach the finish line as fast as possible to climb the global leaderboard.

Navigate the Corporate Gauntlet

  • Deploy your employee ID badge and razor-sharp chair-wrangling skills to beat the clock.

  • Outsmart the dreaded Facilities Department, who’ve filled every corridor with passive-aggressive obstacles designed to slow you down.

  • Master the art of controlled chaos as you drift, roll, and spin your way to glory.

Descend Through the Facility

  • Start your chair-piloting journey on B1 and work your way deeper—B2, B3, and beyond—unlocking new test floors as you conquer each course.

  • Scan your keycard to access restricted levels buried beneath ChairCo HQ.

  • Compete against your personal bests—or take on the entire ChairCo team—to claim your name in blazing red LED lights.

  • Each floor features its own scoreboard, tracking your best and last times alongside company-wide records.

Do you have what it takes to become ChairCo’s top-gun rolling-chair pilot?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 support, x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 1300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
